$Comment: The Heartwinder's fighting phases (DESIGN.md 7). Copied from vanilla Template_Boss_Goblin_Gobliterator_Phase3 (the evaluator wiring, the NoAim and Flamethrower sub states, the death sequence) with the Glutton's Steam Charge as the Boilerback has it, and added: the Wind Up key check (.WindUp), the crash and Scalded Gears stuns, the Lash turn (.Lash), and the climax (.Overwind, .Seized, .Midnight) driven by the encounter's beacons. Built by tools/models/heartworks/heartwinder.npc.roles.mjs.

MaxHealth.Description: Max health; the same in every phase role so the boss bar never jumps (DESIGN.md 7.1)

DisableDamageGroups.Description: Groups it takes no damage from (its own adds)

Invulnerable.Description: Whether it is invulnerable when this role starts and on each state entry

DetectRange.Description: Range at which it notices players (the whole arena)

MeleeDistance.Description: Distance it keeps from its target

ChargeSpeed.Description: Steam Charge speed, blocks a second

ChargeDistance.Description: How far the Steam Charge runs

ChargeLockOn.Description: Seconds it locks on before the wind-up

StunHold.Description: Seconds stunned after a charge into a wall, after the 0.5 s crash (3 s in all)

ScaldHold.Description: Seconds stunned by Scalded Gears (a primed pylon), after the 0.5 s crash (8 s in all)

SeizeTime.Description: Seconds seized when all four brakes are on

Stationary.Description: A turret (phase 3): it only turns to face its target, it never walks

LashChargeTime.Description: Mainspring Lash: seconds standing still before the bands sweep

LashSweepTime.Description: Mainspring Lash: seconds the bands sweep

LashTurnSpeed.Description: Mainspring Lash: degrees a second it turns

TossTrackTime.Description: Gear Toss: seconds it keeps turning to its target in the 1.0 s wind-up

ChargeTwice.Description: Hard mode: every Steam Charge chains straight into a second one

TossTurnSpeed.Description: Gear Toss: relative turn speed while it tracks (a little slow, so a running player gains on it)

StateTransitions.$Comment: Clear the action clip when a charge, a stun or the climax ends.

Instructions.$Comment: No regeneration in the fight (vanilla bosses).
Make it vulnerable on every state entry: a role swap keeps the encounter's invulnerability (READ RoleChangeSystem; DESIGN.md 13 R8). The Overwind sub state sets it again.
The encounter starts the climax.
All four brakes are on.
The countdown ran out.
Idle: the whole arena is in sight; any player there is a target.
Combat, run by the phase's evaluator (_CombatConfig).
Overwind (the climax): invulnerable, winding the countdown; the encounter runs the clock and the brakes.
Seized (four brakes): 12 s of double damage, then back to the fight.
Midnight (the brakes failed): the chime, then back to the fight.
Crashed into a wall: 3 s stunned.
Scalded Gears (a primed pylon burst on it): 8 s stunned at +50% damage taken (the effect).
After a charge that hit or missed: 1 s to recover. Hard mode (ChargeTwice): the first charge chains straight into a second (.ChargeAgain); the flag is cleared when it is back in .Default.
Hard mode: 0.8 s to turn on the spot with a fresh whistle, then a second Steam Charge (lock-on and wind-up again: the same tells).

A Grit Oiler got through (Gibson round 2 note 27): its jam marker is on the boss and it is not already jammed. Sensed after the climax and the stun sub states, so it never cuts a Scalded or Seized window short. Apply the 3 s Grit_Jammed at once (it also blocks a second start), then seize.
Grit in the gears: 3 s seized, the key jams with a grinding bang and sparks (the Key Jam clip, then the stun clip).
Keep every player in the arena in its memory.
Store the evaluator's target in the marked target slot (vanilla).

The Steam Charge (the Glutton's, as the Boilerback has it): lock on 0.6 s, a 1.2 s unblockable wind-up, up to 24 blocks at 20 a second. A wall stops it (3 s stun); a primed pylon's volume scalds it (8 s).
A primed pylon burst on it: Scalded Gears.
Give up if the target is already in reach.
Aiming too long: give up.
Winding up: the clip, steam jets, the whistle, the stampede line; unblockable.
A wall: crash and stun.
Hit a player: barge, stop.
Missed: skid to a stop.
NoAim (vanilla): a rooted telegraph, the move and its recovery in one blocking sequence; the evaluator picks NoAimDefault after.

Wind Up: rooted for its 2.5 s; then the evaluator reads the damage it took meanwhile (RecentSustainedDamage: cleared when the evaluator last ran, which was when it chose the Wind Up) and picks Key_Jam or Wound_Tight.

Gear Toss (round 4, Gibson note 32): it keeps turning to its target for the first 0.8 s of the 1.0 s wind-up (body and head), then holds still so the last 0.2 s and the throw are fair to dodge; the lanes are attached and turn with it. An NPC Aim cannot lead a target without a ballistic weapon, so this is the tracking.
Mainspring Lash (the Gobliterator Flamethrower's turn): still for the charge, then it turns at a fixed rate while the bands sweep.
Default: walk into reach (a turret in phase 3, MaxSpeed 0.1); the evaluator picks the moves.
Hard mode: the next Steam Charge may chain again.
A turret: turn the body to the aim, never walk.
No target left: stand down.
Run Down (DESIGN.md 7.3): the key stops, the heart dims, it sags; steam and a last tick. The encounter opens the vault when the slot empties.
